tools.name: explain_difficulty_rating
tools.description: Explain La Cumbre Cotidiana's three-axis hiking difficulty system (physical 1-10, technical A-G, sun exposure I-III), including what each level means in practice and the associated safety implications.

tools.name: get_route_details
tools.description: Fetch the full detail page for one hiking route as markdown, given its slug or URL as returned by search_hiking_routes.

slug.description: Route slug (the last path segment of a /ruta/ URL) or a full route URL.

tools.name: list_education_articles
tools.description: List La Cumbre Cotidiana mountain-education articles — hiking safety, gear, training and conservation — optionally filtered by topic keyword.

topic.description: Keyword to match against article title, theme or summary.

tools.name: search_hiking_routes
tools.description: Search La Cumbre Cotidiana's catalog of hiking routes near Monterrey, Mexico. Filter by difficulty (physical 1-10, technical 1-7, sun exposure 1-3), distance, or area. Returns matching routes with their stats and canonical URLs.

query.description: Free-text match against route name, area, or description.

maxPhysical.description: Maximum physical difficulty, 1-10. Use 3 for beginners, 6 for moderately fit hikers.

maxTechnical.description: Maximum technical difficulty, 1-7 (A-G). Use 2 to restrict to walking trails with no scrambling.

maxSolar.description: Maximum sun exposure, 1-3. Use 2 or lower for summer or midday hikes.

area.description: Restrict to a named area or massif.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 8.
